description: Bounded P3.17 Brain Handoff lifecycle evidence: current OMP-primary source session creates a canonical handoff envelope, a second real OMP-primary session consumes it through the Hermes adapter code path, and losslessness/boundedness/economics are proven from real artifacts only. No large payloads are stored here -- IDs, hashes, refs, and bounded metrics only.

handoff_creation.cli_command: second_brain handoff create <session_id> --source-harness omp --target-harness hermes --project second-brain --json

integrity_proof.note: capsule_sha256 recomputed independently on the consumer side from the resolved payload matches the source-side value exactly, byte-for-byte, without any conversation-history transport.

boundedness_and_economics.naive_baseline: pasting the full capsule + requirement ledger inline instead of a bounded envelope reference
boundedness_and_economics.note: Only the envelope (1462 bytes) is ever placed in a tool-call argument or model-visible context; the 61071-byte payload remains in the content-addressed Artifact Store and is resolved on demand, not transported. Provider-side cache/token counters were not exposed by this harness path, so no cache savings are claimed; only measured byte/estimated-token figures are reported.
